title: Informational leaflets — Cover design options
slide_intent: Teach designers to decide how strongly a photograph should carry the cover and where the title will remain easy to read.
strategic_value: The same program can publish a simple internal guide or a more image-led introduction while retaining the curved field and program signature.
demonstration: Three examples hold the competition guide title steady and compare a red typographic cover, a split photo-and-text cover and a full-image cover.
practical_value: Choose the split version when a separate text field will protect legibility. Choose a full photograph when its crop and tonal range can support the title.

content_islands.name: Selection notes
content_islands.spec: Place three numbered explanations beside the covers, connecting each treatment to its reading and production demands.

content_islands.name: Cover comparison
content_islands.spec: Align three portrait covers at equal scale. Change the proportion of photo, type and plain color while retaining the title, curve and program mark.
